Position limits come from the compiled MJCF; effort limits are its actuator
forcerange (150/150/150/28/28/28 N m). Velocity limits are pi rad/s, matching:
https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_ROS2_Description/blob/rolling/config/ur5e/joint_limits.yaml
The latter source was checked on 2026-11-16; it declares acceleration limits unavailable.
No FR3 acceleration or synthetic-friction reference is applied to UR5e.
